note: Parapet backdrop in three planes cut from assets/castle.jpg. Device px = image px of castle.jpg (1920x1080 on a 960x540 CSS screen at DPR 2). Every plane is 32 device px (16 CSS px) wider than the screen on each side: place each plane container at left:-16px, top:0, 992x540 CSS, and translate it horizontally only. Stacking (back to front): sky, sky-detail, castle, lit-windows, lake-shimmer, fg-left + fg-right. Children sit inside their plane's container at the given CSS offsets so they follow its parallax.

planes.name: sky
planes.note: half resolution (992x540 px drawn at 992x540 CSS): opaque, no alpha

planes.name: sky-detail
planes.note: moon and right-hand snowy ridges at full resolution over the half-res sky

planes.name: castle
planes.note: castle, rock, mist, lake, boathouse; alpha 0 in the sky

planes.name: lit-windows
planes.note: opacity 0 at rest; windows.json for the wave

planes.name: lake-shimmer
planes.note: Ambiance vivante only; not in the DOM when it is off

moon.note: screen CSS px at rest (plane offset already removed)

logo-shadow.webp.note: static element under the focused logo; animate only its opacity (and the same transform as the logo)

lake-shimmer.note: two ripple phases of the lake reflections, normal blend over the castle plane (child of it, so it follows its parallax). Living ambience only: a at opacity 1, b cross-fading 0..1..0 over ~4 s, or b alone 0..0.85..0 over the original.

lake-mist-tile.webp.note: same look and scale as assets/mist.png (displayed 960 CSS px wide), seamless horizontally: lay two side by side in one strip of 1920 CSS px, translateX(0 -> -960px) linear infinite, 120 s or slower

mist-wake.webp.note: head at the right; trails the rider, fades by opacity and drifts a few px by transform
